ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity black to 25% high-intensity white across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central pigmentation with high-contrast white mottling localized on the distal-lateral regions of both lobes; left lobe white patch shows vertical black striations; right lobe white patch is more fragmented.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at 50-60 degrees; lower vertex partially obscured by splash turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; multiple deep secondary notches visible on the inner-left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curve extending from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively on the terminal distal edges and tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned white linear disruptions visible on the black-pigmented region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular notch patterns and peripheral barnacle colonization on the distal margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'streaked' or 'raked' texture within the white pigment zones on the outer lobe extremities.
